d:
"Yeh Ladki Hai Allah", the wedding song, from 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham'- also known as K3G, features the voice of Alka Yadnik and Udit Narayan. This Blockbuster Bollywood movie is one of India's most loved Family Drama - with the perfect mix of emotions, drama and romance. The movie stars 6 superstars - Amitabh Bachchan, Jaya Bachchan, Shah Rukh Khan, Kajol, Hrithik Roshan and Kareena Kapoor. This is Bollywood in all its grandeur and flamboyance in this one chartbuster song
Song Name - Yeh Ladki Hai Allah
Movie - Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
Singer - Alka Yadnik and Udit Narayan
